items.name: Transaction isolation levels
items.explanation: An isolation level sets what a transaction can see of other transactions running at the same time. Stricter levels such as repeatable read and serializable rule out more surprises, at the cost of more conflicts.

assumedBy.quote: Default transaction isolation level in MySQL is Repeatable Read, and is used in UDB.

items.name: Quorum reads and writes in Cassandra
items.explanation: Cassandra lets each read or write say how many replicas must answer. Quorum means a majority of them, so one slow or overloaded replica can slow the whole request.

assumedBy.quote: Since we perform reads and writes with quorum consistency level, all queries to the nodes that serve the hot partition suffer latency increases, resulting in broader end-user impact.

items.name: Snowflake IDs
items.explanation: A snowflake ID is a 64-bit number whose top bits are a timestamp, so IDs sort by creation time and can be issued without one central counter.

assumedBy.quote: Every ID we use is a Snowflake

sources.title: Discord Developer Documentation: API Reference, Snowflakes
